officialSources.publisher: Yuzhou Municipal Government / Yuzhou Natural Resources and Planning Bureau
officialSources.observation: The official organization page assigns the bureau citywide unified natural-resource and real-estate registration, cadastral investigation, cadastral surveying/dispute handling, registration-result application, and management of a unified registration information platform. This is local custodian evidence, not open parcel geometry.

Official 2025 land-use auction notice names the Yuzhou Natural Resources and Planning Bureau as the grantor and lists public land parcel numbers and locations. It points to the Henan online land-rights trading system, not a cadastral polygon service.

Official procedure page refers to cadastral survey reports and survey boundary maps and gives the Yuzhou government-service real-estate counter. It does not expose a public map/API or safe anonymous parcel geometry.
